description: This file defines an interface for reading staff-related data within the Fineract platform. It declares methods for retrieving staff information, including individual staff details, staff lists for dropdowns, loan officers in an office, staff in an office hierarchy, and associated items.

classes.name: StaffReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for retrieving staff-related data within the Fineract platform. Declares methods for fetching staff information based on various criteria.

methods.name: retrieveStaff
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific staff member given their ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllStaffForDropdown
methods.description: Retrieves a list of staff data suitable for populating a dropdown menu, for a specific office.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanOfficersInOfficeById
methods.description: Retrieves all loan officers within a specific office.

methods.name: retrieveAllStaffInOfficeAndItsParentOfficeHierarchy
methods.description: Returns all staff in offices that are above the provided office ID, optionally filtering for loan officers only.

methods.name: retrieveAllStaff
methods.description: Retrieves all staff in a specific office, filtered by loan officers and status.

methods.name: hasAssociatedItems
methods.description: Checks if a staff member has associated items, returning an array of related object identifiers or status.
